Name: Better Junimos Forestry
Author: ceruleandeep
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/8992/8992-1626168713-833769729.png[/img]

Junimos are the keepers of the forest, and now they can grow a forest or fruit orchard (or just a giant field of turnips) for you.

[list]
[*] grow crops around trees -- good for your environment, good use of space
[*] sustainably harvest wood, never run out
[*] take care of twigs, rocks, and debris
[/list]
Drop a Junimo hut into the middle of your messy, uncleared, unhoed field and let the Junimos sort it out!

This mod adds 10 extra abilities to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2221]Better Junimos[/url].[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/750]
[/url]﻿[/size]
Click on your Junimo hut and choose whether it should be for crops, a wild tree forest, or a fruit tree orchard.

[size=3][b][size=3]To change other configuration options: [/size][/b][size=3]run the mod once to generate the config.json then edit it. Or Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to use the easy configuration menu. [/size][/size]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/8992/8992-1626171267-1090954279.gif[/img]﻿

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/8992/8992-1626171268-2003892787.gif[/img]

(These videos were made with all the settings turned up to 11... big stacks of seeds, lots of Junimos, super-fast working. Don't worry, the default settings are much more leisurely for that laid-back country life.)

[size=3][b][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/8711/8711-1620835492-419642025.png[/img]
[/size][/b][/size]
[b]Normal mode[/b]:

[list]
[*] collects dropped objects (fiber, stone, clay, ...)
[*] harvests debris (twigs, rocks, ...)
[*] cuts grass
[/list]
[b]Crops mode[/b]:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/thumbnails/8992/8992-1626168693-2103882763.png[/img]

[list]
[*] hoes the entire field
[*] cuts down any trees
[*] fills it with crops
[/list]

[b]Orchard mode[/b]:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/thumbnails/8992/8992-1626168701-2054130194.png[/img]

[list]
[*] plants fruit trees
[*] clears debris to keep fruit trees growing
[*] when trees are grown, grows crops around them
[*]harvests the fruit off the trees, naturally!
[/list]

[b]Forest mode[/b]:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/thumbnails/8992/8992-1626168696-1306688529.png[/img]
[list]
[*] plants wild tree seeds
[*] fertilizes wild trees
[*] hoes around wild tree saplings, grows crops in the spaces
[*] when tree is fully grown and seeded, harvests it for wood and replants
[/list]
[b]Maze mode[/b]:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7qhCquj.png[/img]
[list]
[*] plants trellis crops and ground crops to make a maze

[*]hoes the ground as required

[/list][size=3]
[/size][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/8711/8711-1620835500-986425414.png[/img]﻿

[*][size=3]REQUIRES SMAPI[/size]
[*][size=3]REQUIRES Better Junimos. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2221]Download from Nexus[/url]﻿﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]USES [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ if installed ([b]recommended[/b])[/size]
[/list][list]
